situation: The same cache policy was exercised on a slower storage fixture.
expectation: A batch of 20 writes would retain the best measured latency.
action: Compared the 20-write choice with a 10-write batch under the changed fixture.
observed_outcome: The 10-write batch completed sooner, so the earlier choice applies less broadly than expected.
applicability: Only the slower-storage demonstration fixture; it is not a universal cache rule.
evidence: A deterministic demonstration fixture showing the shape of counterevidence.
